skill.name: defou-workflow
skill.description: Transforms raw ideas into structured Simplified Chinese content reports in the Defou style.
skill.summary: Creates Defou-style topic angles, drafts, hooks, scoring, and publishing guidance from rough notes.
skill.author: wangdefou-dev

security_audit.summary: The static shell execution findings are false positives caused by Markdown inline code and a fenced Markdown report template. The obfuscation heuristic is also a false positive because SKILL.md is readable Markdown. A medium contextual issue remains: the workflow directs the agent to write reports to a hardcoded absolute local path.

remediation.suggestion: Replace the fixed `/Users/Wangdefou/Claude Code Archive` path with a user-provided or workspace-relative path.

remediation.issue: Automatic file creation without path confirmation
remediation.suggestion: Ask for confirmation before creating directories or writing generated reports to disk.

static_findings.snippet: -   **文件名规则**: 使用原文件名(不含扩展名),加上 `_report.md` 后缀。例如:`example.md` -> `example_report.md`。

static_findings.pattern: [HEURISTIC] High file entropy (7.09 bits) - possible binary/encrypted content

finding_verdicts.reason: The flagged text is a Markdown inline-code path in prose. There is no Ruby code, shell execution, or command construction at SKILL.md line 76.
The flagged text is a filename rule and example using Markdown inline code. It does not execute a command or interpolate user input into a shell.
The backticks start a fenced Markdown output template. The block describes report formatting and is not executable Ruby or shell content.
SKILL.md is readable Markdown with YAML front matter, Chinese prose, and formatting symbols. I found no binary, encrypted, or intentionally obfuscated content.

semantic_findings.title: Hardcoded Absolute Output Path
semantic_findings.description: The skill instructs the assistant to save generated Markdown to `/Users/Wangdefou/Claude Code Archive` and create the directory if missing. This can write user content outside the active project without an explicit user-selected path.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The filesystem write behavior is stated directly in the workflow instructions. The risk is contextual rather than malicious, because it saves generated content and does not exfiltrate data.

content.value_statement: Raw ideas often lack a clear angle, structure, and publishing judgment. This skill turns notes into focused Chinese content reports with drafts, hooks, scores, and timing guidance.
actual_capabilities: Analyzes raw text and proposes three sharp topic angles.
Selects one best angle using the stated Defou values.
Generates five Simplified Chinese content drafts from fixed templates.
Creates four hook styles for each draft.
Scores each draft across curiosity, resonance, clarity, and share value.
Recommends a publishing time window with a short reason.
limitations: It is designed for Simplified Chinese outputs and a restrained Defou tone.
It does not verify facts or perform external audience research.
It uses fixed templates and scoring dimensions.
Its default save instruction uses a hardcoded local path.

use_cases.title: Turn Notes Into Social Posts
use_cases.description: Convert rough personal notes into structured Chinese posts with hooks, drafts, and publishing guidance.

use_cases.title: Evaluate Content Angles
use_cases.description: Compare several angles and choose the one with the strongest Defou-style judgment and long-term value.

use_cases.title: Package Thought Leadership
use_cases.description: Transform business or learning insights into concise posts with clear arguments and reusable structures.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Report
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request with one idea or short note.
prompt_templates.prompt: Turn this rough idea into a Defou-style content report: [paste your idea].

prompt_templates.title: Analyze an Article
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request using an existing article or draft.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this article and generate a Defou-style report with angles, drafts, hooks, scores, and publish time: [paste article].

prompt_templates.title: Compare Multiple Ideas
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced planning across several possible topics.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare these ideas, choose the strongest Defou-style angle, and create the full report from that angle: [paste ideas].

prompt_templates.title: Refine for a Channel
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request with audience and platform constraints.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create the report for [platform] and [audience]. Keep the Defou tone, strengthen the hook options, and explain the scoring decisions.

output_examples.input: Notes about time management, distraction, and unfinished plans.
output_examples.output: A Markdown report that selects a structure-first angle, provides five Chinese draft options, scores each option, and recommends an evening publish window.

output_examples.input: A draft post about career growth and tool overload.
output_examples.output: A sharper content plan that reframes the topic around decision quality, adds four hook styles per draft, and identifies the strongest recommendation.

best_practices: Provide enough source material for the skill to compare several angles.
State the intended audience and platform before generating the report.
Review the selected angle and scores before publishing the final draft.
anti_patterns: Do not use it for fact-checking or source validation.
Do not expect a neutral brand voice outside the Defou style.
Do not allow automatic file writes without confirming the destination path.

faq.question: What language does this skill use?
faq.answer: The skill is designed to produce Simplified Chinese content.

faq.question: Does it write final posts or only outlines?
faq.answer: It writes full draft options, hooks, scoring notes, and publishing guidance.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude, Codex, or Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it research current trends?
faq.answer: No. It works from the text you provide and does not perform external research.

faq.question: Why does it mention a local save path?
faq.answer: The workflow asks the agent to save reports to a fixed local directory. Confirm or change the path before writing files.

faq.question: What kind of voice does it create?
faq.answer: It creates calm, concise, judgment-led Chinese content with a Defou-style perspective.
